title: Discovery of Novel N-Sulfonamide-tetrahydroquinolines as Potent Retinoic Acid Receptor-Related Orphan Receptor gammat (RORgammat) Inverse Agonists for the Treatment of Psoriasis.
authors: Lv, Lunan; Chen, Baiyu; Gao, Yang; Sun, Nannan; Li, Wei; Fu, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文主要研究RORgammat小分子反向激动剂的合成与抗银屑病药效，虽用MD模拟解释配体-受体机制，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Guided by the mode of action of 13, our previously discovered RORgammat inverse agonist, we conducted five rounds of design syntheses and structure-activity relationship (SAR) studies, ultimately identifying RORgammat inverse agonist 5a, which exhibited superior in vitro activity compared to 13. Besides, 5a showed promising therapeutic effects in alleviating psoriasis in mice by intraperitoneal injection. Due to the high lipophilicity and in vitro pharmacokinetic properties of 5a, it was formulated into an ointment, which enabled effective skin retention and mitigated systemic side effects. The ointment of 5a was assessed in the mouse model, where it demonstrated significant antipsoriatic effects, superior to 13 and comparable to the positive control GSK2981278, without obvious toxicity. Furthermore, we elucidated molecular mechanism of action for inverse agonist 5a and agonist 1e by means of molecular dynamics (MD) simulation. In summary, 5a holds great promise as a novel antipsoriatic drug candidate.
abstract_zh: 在我们先前发现的RORγt反向激动剂13的作用模式指导下，我们进行了五轮设计合成及构效关系（SAR）研究，最终鉴定出RORγt反向激动剂5a，其体外活性优于13。此外，5a通过腹腔注射在小鼠中显示出缓解银屑病的良好治疗效果。鉴于5a的高亲脂性和体外药代动力学特性，将其制备成软膏剂，能够实现有效的皮肤滞留并减轻全身性副作用。在小鼠模型中评估了5a软膏，显示出显著的抗银屑病效果，优于13且与阳性对照GSK2981278相当，无明显毒性。进一步地，我们通过分子动力学（MD）模拟阐明了反向激动剂5a和激动剂1e的分子作用机制。总之，5a作为新型抗银屑病候选药物具有巨大潜力。
